songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
(clear, high-energy)
Battleships glide through silent dark!
Crimson beams leave a burning mark!
Cyan lances cut the night!
Space ignites in blinding light!
Distant nukes like dying stars!
Gleaming steel and plasma scars!
Chaos blooming pure and bright!
Most magnificent sight!

[Pre-Chorus]
(building distorted synth lift)
Boarding pod locked on target hull!
Plasma torch through the titan's skull!
Force the airlock! Step inside!
Nowhere for the machines to hide!

[Chorus]
(soaring pitched-up vocal, heavy hardstyle kick)
Celestial breach! Power core target!
Starfire burning across the dark!
Beautiful war! Supernova glow!
Watch the enemy titan blow!

[Verse 2]
(fast, aggressive flow)
Metal droids fall to the floor!
Fighting through to the engine core!
Antimatter charges set to spark!
Countdown ticking in the dark!
Pure destruction, cold and sweet!
Engine room under our feet!
Beautiful flame! Glorious sight!
Shining through eternal night!

[Bridge]
(euphoric breakdown, soaring piano and heavy distorted leads)
Thrusters maxed! Launch the pod!
Escaping the wrath of a metal god!
Hull ruptures! Reactor breaks!
Silent shockwave space awakes!

[Chorus]
(soaring pitched-up vocal, full power)
Celestial breach! Power core target!
Starfire burning across the dark!
Beautiful war! Supernova glow!
Watch the enemy titan blow!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum euphoric energy, layered bass)
Celestial breach! Power core target!
Starfire burning across the dark!
Beautiful war! Supernova glow!
Watch the enemy titan blow!

[Outro]
(fading fast synth lead, explosion echo)
Shockwave hits! Pod survives!
Brightest flash of our lives!
Titan burns in golden light!
Most beautiful night!
